content.value: A boiler plant consists of an economiser, a boiler and a superheater. Feed water leaves the economiser at 85°C and leave the boiler drum with 95% quality at 15 bar. The same gets superheated to 250°C in the superheater. If the feed water of 34°C supplied to the economiser at the rate of 10 kg of coal fired, calculate-
(i) The efficiency of the plant assuming calorific value of coal is 32.6x 103 kJ/kg, and (ii) the percentage of total heat absorbed by the economiser, boiler and superheater.
